parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the model operator instance.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. The time is in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format and is displayed in UTC.

parameters.name: LogType
parameters.description:
The log type. Set the value to:

- **sls**

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of records to return on each page. Valid values: **30**, **50**, and **100**.

The default value is **100**.

parameters.name: RelativeDBClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the PolarDB cluster.

parameters.name: Reverse
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return the results in reverse order. The default value is *false*.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start of the time range to query. The time is in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format and is displayed in UTC.
